Overview

Newport News is a city in VA with a population of 180,000. Hampton Roads city with Newport News Shipbuilding and the Mariners’ Museum. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8a growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.2.
